name: Raven Hill
summary: In western Duskwood, Raven Hill lies in ruins beneath the shadow of its vast cemetery. Frightened squatters and invisible spirits are all that remain of the once lively human settlement.

sections.title: A Town Lost to Darkness
sections.body: Raven Hill stands along Duskwood’s western road, just north of Addle’s Stead, a shell of its former self. When dark magic and undead horrors swept through the Grand Hamlet region, the living fled east toward Darkshire or left the territory. Now ruined timber homes decay beneath the gloom. Travelers avoid them, fearing restless dead from the neighboring cemetery and the invisible Unseen among the crumbling walls.

sections.title: The Few Who Remain
sections.body: Only a handful remain among Raven Hill’s ruins. Jitters, a nervous adventurer, hides in the abandoned structures, terrified of the horrors stalking the woods. In a dilapidated attic, the goblin Bliztik ekes out a solitary living by selling supplies to wary passersby. They share the ruins with the invisible spirits called the Unseen, at the edge of the sprawling burial grounds.

faq.answer: Raven Hill was abandoned when darkness fell over Duskwood, bringing undead horrors, dark magic, and predatory beasts. So close to the vast cemetery, the town was difficult to defend, and survivors fled east toward Darkshire.

faq.q: Who actually lives in the village now?
faq.answer: Only a few desperate or daring souls remain. Jitters, a terrified human, hides among the ruined foundations, plagued by guilt and fear. Bliztik, a goblin vendor, works from an upper floor and trades with anyone brave enough to search the abandoned buildings.

faq.q: What are the Unseen haunting Raven Hill?
faq.answer: The Unseen are invisible, hostile spirits that wander Raven Hill and the nearby cemetery. Their presence can become a sudden, deadly threat to any unwary traveler exploring the desolate township.

faq.q: Where does the road through Raven Hill lead?
faq.answer: The road past Raven Hill runs west toward the river bridge into Westfall, south toward Addle’s Stead and the border of Stranglethorn Vale, and east through Duskwood to Darkshire.

angles.text: For Alliance travelers crossing the bridge from Westfall, Raven Hill offers an ominous welcome to the nightmare overtaking western Duskwood.
As a human, these decaying cottages show how much territory the kingdom of Stormwind has lost to creeping darkness and neglect.
